content:
## Overview
Manage your prepaid funds and review infrastructure costs.

## Prerequisites
- Felcloud account

## Procedure
1. Access the Billing section of the dashboard.
2. Review your current TND balance and estimated burn rate.
3. Click 'Top Up' to add funds using supported payment methods.
4. View historical usage to see per-second deductions.

## Troubleshooting
If resources are suspended despite having balance, please open a support ticket.
